scope: Q3 only; upstream Q2 curved response and all 200 joint draws; frozen power baseline comparison
design_scenarios: All 200 Q2 curved joint cell-bootstrap rows, with original draw IDs
independent_evaluation: Generate new cell-bootstrap fits with the specified seed. Evaluate fixed nominal and robust decisions on these rows without tuning either decision. Report maximum, mean and top-10-percent mean regret. This is conditional Monte Carlo sensitivity from the same data, not independent real training data.
cost_sensitivity: Re-solve separate common-cost scenarios at 0.5 and 2.0 cost multipliers; also evaluate each stored actual (N,D,Q) under changed costs, reporting infeasibility instead of silently recomputing D.
model_sensitivity: Compare power and curved nominal configurations; evaluate both decisions under each model. Independent power resampling is a separate structural sensitivity, not mixed into a single statistical confidence interval.
global_bounds: For Q in [a,b], use h(a) and g(log b) to form a lower loss for every N. Minimize the finite maximum over log N using opposing convex support lines. Branch until a feasible upper minus interval lower is within tolerance, including individual regret-baseline errors.
uncertainty: Preserve whole joint parameter rows. Report support exceedance, boundary mass and broad configuration intervals.
near_optimal: Representative quality-profile and fixed-quality N sublevel sets at absolute Loss tolerance 0.001; do not present their Cartesian product as a joint feasible region.
saturation: Use gamma(Q)=(delta-2*kappa*log Q)/beta. Distinguish local Q=1 KKT candidates, globally checked transition brackets and conservative sufficient high-budget bounds.
integration: Versioned Q3 handoff; no Q4 or manuscript modification in this stage.
